name: Multi-scale Interactive Ray Sampling
definition: A technique to project high-dimensional interaction features into a compact 4D space ($R^4$) using ray sampling, allowing retrieval of deformable features from local 4D deformable fields by maximizing sampling probability.
summary: Multi-scale Interactive Ray Sampling projects high-dimensional interaction features into a compact 4D space using K-Planes, enabling efficient iterative sampling from coarse to fine scales.
